title: A sprint whose start warns that most items share one file gets a gate before it starts, not a fully serial run
goal: when backlog.py start warns that a file is in the touches of more than half of the sprint's items, host-check or the start gate names it as a planning finding to split or order before the start; SP-dulvwwjc started with _tools/mon_status.py in four of six items and every work item ran one after another

run: import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','host-check','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'share' in p.stdout else 1)
